title: Elysian Band — Petite
subtitle: The Elysian Cut™ set full circle — an elongated light that never closes.

stone.origin: Natural. Full eternity. Bez Ambar proprietary elongated cut.

description: The Elysian Cut™ — Bez Ambar's own elongated form, falling somewhere between an oval and a baguette and cut for a different quality of light — set full circle in eighteen-karat white gold. In its petite scale the stones sit close and fine, a continuous run of elongated light that never closes on the finger. It is the most restrained expression of the cut: quiet enough for every day, distinct enough to be recognised. Made as a full eternity, with a halfway version available.
